event_name: Date 24 July 2022 Time 15:26 2022 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 July 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that OCO is predominantly to blame for the collision with TSU. OCO was attempting to overtake TSU at the entry to T8. He lost control of the rear of the car and collided with TSU, who had left enough space for an overtaking manoeuvre by OCO.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
